title: Heavenly Eye's Fury
next_chapter_hook: The moment he stepped into the secret realm, Chen Ji saw himself three months later, standing atop a massive skeleton—with a lingering look of unwilling venom still in its eye sockets.

text.content:
At that moment, the sky shattered.

Not metaphorically—it truly shattered. Three golden rays shot冲天而起, tearing apart the sky for a hundred miles in all directions, revealing a soul-chilling deep purple Void. In that Void, an eye was slowly opening.

Chen Ji felt his soul being gripped by an invisible hand, each heartbeat crushed under that gaze. He saw his skin beginning to crack, fine beads of blood seeping from his pores, staining the edges of his shattered robe.

Chen Nian死死抓住哥哥的衣袖，指节发白。她能感受到那注视中蕴含的毁灭性力量——那是天道对蝼蚁的漠视，对妄图窥探天机者的清算。

"哥哥……"她的声音在颤抖，"它在找你。"

Chen Ji did not answer. He死死盯着那只正在睁开的眼睛，脑海中疯狂运转。Mo Xiansheng的话如同惊雷般在耳边回响——天道之眼，灭世之瞳。这是超越一切的存在，连元婴老怪在它面前都不过是尘埃。

dialogue.content:
"Now is not the time to be stunned!" Ye Qing's voice cut through the fog of fear like a blade, "Chen Ji, does that broken book of yours have any solution?"

She formed a seal with one hand, demonic energy surging around her body, creating a jet-black barrier. That barrier trembled violently under that gaze but barely held without shattering. Her face was pale—this was clearly draining her origin.

"Join forces!" Ling Yuan's voice came from the other side, "Brat, I'll admit your cleverness, but hiding your full strength now is seeking death! My sect's protective formation combined with your demonic mist can hold for at least thirty breaths!"

He waved his horsetail whisk, a cyan light撑起半边天空. That old fox who had harbored malicious intentions toward Chen Ji now became the most steadfast ally—because they both understood, facing the Heavenly Eye, only by joining forces was there a sliver of hope.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate. He knew Ling Yuan was right—any reservation now would be foolish.

"Ye Qing, unleash your demonic mist at full power, conceal our presence! Ling Yuan Senior, hold the formation for thirty breaths, I need time!"

His palm pressed against his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating frantically. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Using the Tianji Record consumes five Heavenly Fate points. But with the current pressure... you can only withstand it three times at most."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's gaze grew heavier with each breath, each moment sheer torment. At this life-or-death moment, Chen Ji had to make a decision—

choices.text: Immediately use the Tianji Record to foresee
choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points and immediately see the escape route. The pressure is intensifying, no time for hesitation.
choices.risk_hint: Only 15 Heavenly Fate points remaining, remaining pressure duration unknown

text.content:
Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record without hesitation.

In an instant, his consciousness was pulled into chaos. Countless images flashed like a carousel before finally fixing on one point—three altars scattered at the secret realm's entrance. In the vision, he stood on one of them, alone.

"The only way out... enter the secret realm immediately." Mo Xiansheng's voice came, "But your sister will be drawn into another altar. You... will be separated."

choices.text: First let Ling Yuan and Ye Qing hold the line
choices.description: Buy more time to observe the situation, perhaps find a way that doesn't consume Heavenly Fate.
choices.risk_hint: Pressure is intensifying, strength being drained with each breath

text.content:
Chen Ji chose to wait. He believed Ling Yuan and Ye Qing could hold for at least another twenty breaths.

But he underestimated the horror of the Heavenly Eye. That eye opened another fraction, pressure suddenly increasing by half! Ling Yuan's protective formation emitted a sharp cracking sound, Ye Qing's demonic mist began twisting violently.

"Damn!" Chen Ji cursed internally. The Heavenly Eye's pressure increase far exceeded his expectations—act now, and everyone dies!

"No time to think!" Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, golden light flickering briefly in his pupils.

He saw it—thirty zhang behind the three of them, three ancient altars were emanating a dim glow. Those were the secret realm's entrances, each leading to different trial grounds.

"Chen Nian will be drawn into the second altar, you will be separated." He calculated rapidly in his mind, "But that's the only way out."

The Heavenly Eye's pressure was like a physical mountain, pressing down mercilessly. Ling Yuan's protective formation could finally take no more, cracks spreading like a spider's web.

"Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan roared, "Have you figured out a way or not!"

Ye Qing's demonic mist was also contracting violently, her face already deathly pale.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision—

choice.prompt: The escape route is clear, but the cost is everyone must separate. Chen Ji must decide how to allocate who enters which altar—

choices.text: Let Ling Yuan and Ye Qing provide rearguard
choices.description: Have them cover Chen Ji and Chen Nian's entry into the altars—they have enough strength to escape at the last moment.
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Chen Ji and Chen Nian's safety
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan was always scheming, Ye Qing is the Holy Sect's saint—trusting them carries risk

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke decisively: "Ling Yuan Senior, Ye Qing, please hold for another ten breaths! I'm taking Chen Nian first!"

Ling Yuan's eyes flashed with fury—this was clearly making him a cannon fodder! But he also understood, if they didn't cooperate now, everyone would die.

"Hmph!" He coldly snorted, whipping his horsetail whisk violently, "Ten breaths then! Brat, you'd better not die in there!"

choices.text: All four rush to the first altar together
choices.description: No dispersing, everyone enters the same secret realm together, ensuring concentrated strength.
choices.visible_cost: Might be wiped out by the Heavenly Eye in one stroke
choices.risk_hint: Violates the Tianji Record's foresight of the only way out, might lead to utter destruction

text.content:
Chen Ji grabbed Chen Nian's hand, his gaze firm: "We go together!"

Chen Nian's eyes instantly reddened. All these years, it was the first time her brother didn't treat her as a burden.

"Brother..."

"No nonsense!" Chen Ji growled, pulling her along with Ye Qing and Ling Yuan toward the first altar.

However, just as they were about to step into the altar's light, the Heavenly Eye abruptly focused—

The Heavenly Eye seemed to sense their intention. A purple thunderbolt shot from that enormous eye, targeting Chen Ji's heart!

"Careful!" Ye Qing shoved Chen Ji aside violently, the thunderbolt grazing her shoulder, sending up a spray of blood.

"Ye Qing!" Chen Ji cried out.

"Don't worry about me!" She gritted her teeth, "Enter the altar! Quickly!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian suddenly broke free from her brother's hand and ran to stand before Chen Ji, looking up at him. Her eyes held no fear, only a heartbreaking calm.

"Brother, the Tianji Record shows I'll enter the second altar, right?"

Chen Ji's heart clenched—how could she know?

Chen Nian gave a faint smile: "I'm the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, any foresight about me is blurred. Brother... don't change your plans for me."

text.content:
At that moment, Chen Ji felt his heart being gripped tightly.

He looked at this girl who had followed behind him since childhood, calling out "Brother, brother." When the Holy Sect took her away, he was only twelve. He swore he would find her.

Now, she stood here, already grown into a young woman who could stand on her own. And the first thing she said was to ask him not to change his plans for her.

"No." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, "I won't abandon you."

dialogue.content:
"Brother!" Chen Nian stamped her foot anxiously, "I'm not begging you! I'm telling you, this is the only way out!"

She took a deep breath, eyes brimming with tears but forcing them not to fall: "The Heavenly Eye's target is you, not us. As long as you're alive, I have a chance to be rescued. If you die... then I truly have nothing."

"Please, brother." Her voice trembled, "Let me do something for you."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's words cut like a knife. Chen Ji must choose between familial bonds and rational judgment—

choices.description: According to the Tianji Record's foresight, the siblings enter the altars separately, agreeing to meet three months later.
choices.visible_cost: Separated from his sister, life and death uncertain
choices.visible_reward: Gain the only chance to survive
choices.risk_hint: Three months is too long, too many variables

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes. He knew Chen Nian was right. Rationally, entering separately would indeed disperse the Heavenly Eye's attention and increase everyone's survival rate.

But emotionally... how could he possibly accept?

"Three months." He opened his eyes, his voice low as if from the depths of hell, "Three months later, meet at the secret realm's exit. If you're not there..."

He didn't finish. But Chen Nian understood. She nodded vigorously, breaking into a brilliant smile: "It's a promise! Pinky promise!"

choices.description: Disregard the Tianji Record's foresight, forcibly pull Chen Nian and rush toward the first altar.
choices.visible_cost: Violating the foresight might lead to total annihilation
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye is locking onto you

text.content:
Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian to his side, his gaze cold as he swept across the three altars: "I, Chen Ji, never believe in fate. Let's go!"

He pulled Chen Nian and Ye Qing, sprinting toward the first altar at full speed. Ling Yuan hesitated briefly, then gritted his teeth and followed.

The Heavenly Eye seemed to sense their intention—that enormous eye abruptly focused—pressure ten times greater than before descended!

"BOOM!!"

Ling Yuan's protective formation collapsed completely. In that instant, Chen Ji felt a destructive force enveloping him, as if the next second he would turn to ash.

"Now!" Ye Qing exhausted her last bit of strength, pushing the demonic mist to its extreme, forming a thin protective membrane around everyone, "I can't hold long!"

Chen Ji held Chen Nian with one hand, the Tianji Record Fragment in the other, charging toward the altar. Thirty zhang's distance, now felt like three hundred thousand miles.

Twenty zhang.

The Heavenly Eye descended another purple thunderbolt. Ling Yuan slashed backward with one hand, dispersing the thunderbolt but spitting out a mouthful of blood.

"Don't look back!" he roared, "Keep running!"

Ten zhang.

Chen Nian suddenly broke free from her brother's hand and ran toward the second altar.

"Chen Nian!" Chen Ji reached out to grab her, but only caught empty air.

"Brother, as we agreed!" She looked back, eyes full of tears but smiling, "See you in three months!"

Chen Ji stood frozen, watching his sister's figure vanish into the light of the second altar. At that moment, his heart felt like it was being crushed by a hand.

"Chen Ji!" Ye Qing's voice pulled him back to reality, "Your sister has already entered. If you don't go in now, you'll truly be out of time!"

He snapped back to awareness, seeing Ye Qing standing on the third altar, extending her hand toward him. And Ling Yuan, covered in blood, was desperately blocking the Heavenly Eye's third thunderbolt.

dialogue.content:
"Brat!" Ling Yuan's voice came from afar, carrying a strange calm, "What I owed you, today I repay! Next time we meet... it won't be so easy!"

He forcibly mobilized all his true essence, his horsetail whisk transforming into a cyan rainbow, shooting directly at the Heavenly Eye!

"Go!" Chen Ji gritted his teeth, grabbed Ye Qing's hand, and together they jumped into the altar's light.

In the final moment before the light engulfed their vision, Chen Ji saw Ling Yuan's cyan rainbow collide with the Heavenly Eye's enormous pupil, erupting into a purple-cyan intertwined light.

text.content:
The world spun.

Chen Ji felt himself falling in endless void, surrounded by infinite darkness and suffocating pressure. Ye Qing's hand tightly gripped his wrist, her knuckles white.

Time unknown—perhaps a few breaths, perhaps a few hours—until he felt solid ground beneath his feet.

Opening his eyes, what met his gaze was a desolate ruin. The sky was an eerie dark red, the air thick with the stench of decay and death.

"We... made it in." Ye Qing's voice carried the relief of surviving a catastrophe.

Chen Ji did not speak. He raised his hand and looked at the faintly glowing rune on his palm—the mark left when entering the secret realm, the only way to connect with the outside world.

"Three months." He murmured to himself, voice low, "Three months later, meet at the secret realm's exit."

He raised his head and gazed into the distance. At the end of the ruins, a towering peak pierced the clouds, a faint golden light flickering at its summit.

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm suddenly vibrated violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a gravity never seen before:

"Chen Ji, I saw a vision... about you three months from now."

Chen Ji closed his eyes and let his consciousness sink into the Tianji Record's space.

He saw a vision—a mountain of corpses and seas of blood, the air thick with a nauseating smell of burning. At the center of the vision, a figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, drenched in blood yet radiating shocking momentum.

That figure... was himself.

And beneath his feet lay a massive skeleton. In that skeleton's eye sockets, a lingering look of unwilling venom still burned.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat soaking his back.

"Three months from now..." he murmured, "I will personally execute the Heavenly Eye?"
